PILEHEAD
Simulator hubPrint deck
Rules · how to play

Get rid of all your cards. Play an equal or higher number on the pile, or any action card. If you have no legal move, pick up the entire pile. Keep three cards in hand while the draw stock lasts. Then play your face-up cards, followed by your blind face-down cards.

RESET · next number may be any number.
GHOST · transparent; restriction stays.
UNDER ↓4 · next number must be 1–4.
SKIP · next player loses a turn.
BURN · discard the pile, play again.
SLAM! · complete four equal numbers on top, even out of turn; burn and take the next turn.

Start with three face-down cards, three face-up and three in hand. Before playing, you can exchange cards between your hand and face-up row. The final player with cards is the PILEHEAD.
